# Lumen Quality Preview

This file checks **search**, [anchor navigation](#wide-content), and [relative links](tabs-second.md).

## Find in document

Search for the word lightweight. Lumen stays lightweight even on large files.

### Keyboard navigation

Use Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, or Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 to move between tabs.

## Wide content

| Feature | Behavior | A deliberately wide detail column that should remain readable without crushing every column |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tables | Horizontal document scrolling | Columns keep a practical minimum width while the reader remains virtualized |

```text
This deliberately long code line should stay on one line and use horizontal scrolling instead of wrapping into a tall block: 0123456789 ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 0123456789 ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 0123456789
```

## File updates

External edits reload automatically and show a brief File updated toast.
